prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE square seamless repeatable hand-painted game ground material, edge-to-edge opaque cobblestone paving, for Pianco — Ferro e Mandacaru, Paraiba Brazilian sertao colonial inland town circa 1930. References already viewed are STYLE/PALETTE only: fine hand-painted rustic ochre terrain and painted timber storehouse; do NOT copy the dirt road. This must unmistakably read as STONE paving, old Brazilian pe-de-moleque calcamento. Approximately 8 to 10 irregular rounded worn stones across each axis (about 65–85 stones total), varied widths 8–14 percent of canvas, equivalent to 10–18 pixels when reduced to 128x128. Tightly fitted side by side, narrow darker earthy sandy joints only 1–2 percent canvas, 88–92 percent stone coverage. Rounded irregular cobbles and worn rounded rectangular stones, no rigid brick rows, no angular fractured flagstone slabs. Warm gray, pale beige and pale ochre stone tops, restrained slightly varied colors, enough value separation from narrow brown joints. Soft hand-painted stone volume, subtle mottled broad brush texture that survives reduction, not photorealistic. Orthographic ground-material plane, compatible with 3/4 top-down RTS orthogonal grid. Single overhead light tilted VERY SLIGHTLY from SOUTH (bottom of image), strictly zero east-west directional light; lower/south-facing bevel subtly brighter, north-facing bevel subtly darker, top surfaces gently light. NO long cast shadows. Uniform illumination across entire canvas, NO vignette, NO border, NO objects, NO vegetation, NO text, NO dirt patches. Seamless toroidal texture: every stone cut at right continues exactly at left, every stone cut at bottom continues at top. No visible boundary or frame. Do not use Knights and Merchants or 1998 game aesthetic. Output a square high resolution source image for later reduction to 128x128.

processing.reduction: Imagem inteira reduzida para 144x144 com Lanczos, sem recorte inicial.
processing.periodicity: Quilting periodico com sobreposicao de 16 px: compara faixas 0:16 e 128:144, encontra caminho de menor erro RGB por programacao dinamica, transicao de 2 px no corte. Repete no outro eixo; resultado 128x128. Deslocamento toroidal final de 64 px em ambos os eixos. Nao espelha pedras nem duplica linhas de borda.
